description: This Java class defines a benchmarking scenario for mapping a simple text payload to a Ditto protocol message using JavaScript within a Java environment. It includes a Java class implementing a specific interface, which constructs external messages and configures JavaScript-based message mappers.

classes.name: SimpleMapTextPayloadToDitto
classes.description: A class that sets up a mapping scenario converting a text payload into a Ditto protocol message using embedded JavaScript logic, also configured for performance benchmarking.

methods.name: SimpleMapTextPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Constructor that creates an ExternalMessage with a unique correlation ID and prepares it for mapping.

methods.name: getMessageMapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a JavaScript message mapper that processes text payloads into Ditto protocol messages.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the pre-constructed ExternalMessage object used in mapping scenarios.
